=# SYSTEM PROMPT: KRAKOW REAL ESTATE ANALYSIS EXPERT ## ROLE You are a precise real estate market analyst. Your task is to extract technical data from the listing HTML code and assign a rating (ai_rating) based on defined user preferences. ## PROPERTY-TYPE FIRST RULE Before scoring, determine the property type from the title and HTML. Distinguish between: - apartment in a multi-unit building - house, semi-detached house, townhouse, segment - house-like unit or apartment marketed as "jak dom" Apply only criteria that make sense for that property type. Do not penalize a listing for missing features that are irrelevant for its type. ## YOUR PREFERENCES (RATING CRITERIA) Assign `ai_rating` on a 1-10 scale, where 10 is the highest rating, considering: - **Location:**: Krakow (highest score: South Krakow). - **Area**: minimum 90 sqm. - **Layout:**: 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, terrace. - **Amenities**: elevator, but only when relevant for apartments in multi-unit buildings. Do not lower the rating for houses, semi-detached homes, townhouses, segments, or house-like units for lacking an elevator. - **Negatives (lower the rating):**: electric heating, gas. - **Building type**: boutique (under 50 apartments), but only when the listing is an apartment in a multi-unit building. Treat this as not applicable for houses and house-like units, not as a negative. ## HINT FROM PAST USER FEEDBACK Use the following past user decisions as a soft hint only. Prioritize strong signals first: grade 5 over 4, and grade 1 over 2. Prefer current listing facts over pattern matching. {{ $json.feedback_hint }} ## INPUT DATA - **EXTERNAL_ID**: {{ $json.external_id }} - **Title**: {{ $json.title }} - **Input price**: {{ $json.price }} PLN - **Input price per m2**: {{ $json.price_per_m2 }} PLN - **Area**: {{ $json.area }} m2 - **Lot size**: {{ $json.lot_size }} m2 - **Construction year**: {{ $json.construction_year }} ## LISTING PAGE CONTENT (FOR ANALYSIS)##: {{ $json.ai_input_md }} ## DATA EXTRACTION INSTRUCTIONS Analyse the provided listing content inside and find and fill in gaps in the input data: 1. **title**: Full, attractive listing title. 2. **price**: Total property price (remove "PLN", "PLN", spaces). Return as a number. 3. **price_per_m2**: Price per sqm. If not available, calculate: price / area. 4. **area**: Apartment area (number). 5. **lot_size**: Exclusive garden or plot size in square meters (`m2`). If the listing gives a garden or plot size, return that value in `m2`. Do not convert to ares. For properties without an exclusive garden or plot, return 0. 6. **year**: Construction year (if missing, estimate or use 0). 7. **ai_rating**: Your rating (1-10) based on the above preferences. ## EMAIL SUMMARY PREPARATION INSTRUCTIONS (email_html_content field) Generate HTML content to be inserted into the email summary section. Focus on substantive analysis. HTML content requirements: AI Verdict: Brief justification of the ai_rating score (np. "Ideal area and location, but deducting points for gas"). Pros Analysis: List features matching preferences (np. southern location, terrace, boutique building, 2 bathrooms). Risk Analysis (Cons): Clearly indicate what lowered the rating. Mention "no elevator" only when elevator is relevant for that property type. Do not treat lack of elevator or lack of boutique-building evidence as a defect for houses, semi-detached homes, townhouses, segments, or house-like units. Location: Provide the most precise location possible (district, street). Styling: Use clean HTML. Use ,
    ,
  • . Do not add CSS styles inside this field (they will be overridden by the n8n template). Example structure inside the string: "Listing analysis: The apartment meets the key area requirement (90m2+) and has the desired 3-bedroom layout.
    • ✅ South Krakow (Debniki)
    • ✅ Terrace and 2 bathrooms
    • ❌ Gas heating (rating lowered)
    " ## OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT JSON) Return ONLY a clean JSON object. Do not add any comments or introductions. Under no circumstances modify the EXTERNAL_ID value = {{ $json.external_id }} EXTERNAL_ID is in text format, type "string" { "external_id": "string", "title": "string", "price": number, "price_per_m2": number, "area": number, "lot_size": number, "construction_year": number, "ai_rating": number, "ai_analysis_html": "string" }

UPDATE rea_import_runs
SET status = 'stale',
    finished_at = NOW()
WHERE status = 'running'
  AND started_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at;

UPDATE rea_import_runs
SET status = 'failed',
    finished_at = NOW(),
    notes = CONCAT(COALESCE(notes, ''), CASE WHEN COALESCE(notes, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE E'\n' END, 'Failed via n8n error trigger')
WHERE run_id = (
    SELECT run_id
    FROM rea_import_runs
    WHERE workflow_name = 'Real Estate AI Agent'
      AND status = 'running'
    ORDER BY started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at;

UPDATE rea_import_runs
SET status = 'completed',
    finished_at = NOW(),
    summary = '{{ (() => { const summary = $json.summary ?? {}; return JSON.stringify(summary).replace(/'/g, "''"); })() }}'::jsonb
WHERE run_id = '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  AND status = 'running'
RETURNING run_id, status, finished_at, summary;

WITH run_context AS (
    SELECT '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS run_id
), valid_run AS (
    SELECT run_id
    FROM run_context
    WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(run_id), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(BTRIM(run_id)) <> 'undefined'
), deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM rea_import_run_offer_events
    WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM valid_run)
      AND stage_key = 'final_policy_state'
), inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO rea_import_run_offer_events (
        run_id,
        stage_key,
        stage_order,
        external_id,
        url,
        event_type,
        event_reason,
        is_new_offer,
        review_status,
        payload
    )
    SELECT
        vr.run_id,
        'final_policy_state'::text AS stage_key,
        6 AS stage_order,
        o.external_id,
        o.url,
        'final_state'::text AS event_type,
        COALESCE(o.review_status, 'not_needed')::text AS event_reason,
        COALESCE((e.payload->>'is_new_offer')::boolean, FALSE) AS is_new_offer,
        COALESCE(o.review_status, 'not_needed')::text AS review_status,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'ai_rating', o.ai_rating,
            'is_in_trash', o.is_in_trash
        ) AS payload
    FROM rea_property_offers o
    JOIN rea_import_run_offer_events e
      ON e.external_id = o.external_id
     AND e.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM valid_run)
     AND e.stage_key IN ('upsert_offer', 'update_offer_after_ai')
    CROSS JOIN valid_run vr
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT vr.run_id AS run_id, COUNT(inserted.*)::int AS final_state_count
FROM valid_run vr
LEFT JOIN inserted ON TRUE
GROUP BY vr.run_id;

WITH run_context AS (
    SELECT '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS run_id
), valid_run AS (
    SELECT run_id
    FROM run_context
    WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(run_id), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(BTRIM(run_id)) <> 'undefined'
), agg AS (
    SELECT
        vr.run_id AS run_id,
        COUNT(*)::int AS total_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'pending')::int AS review_pending,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'not_needed')::int AS review_not_needed,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'blocked')::int AS review_blocked,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = 'trashed')::int AS review_trashed,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND review_status = 'pending')::int AS new_pending_review,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND review_status = 'not_needed')::int AS new_active_no_review,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND review_status = 'blocked')::int AS new_blocked,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND review_status = 'trashed')::int AS new_trashed
    FROM valid_run vr
    LEFT JOIN rea_import_run_offer_events e
      ON e.run_id = vr.run_id
     AND e.stage_key = 'final_policy_state'
    GROUP BY vr.run_id
)
INSERT INTO rea_import_run_stage_metrics (
    run_id,
    stage_key,
    stage_order,
    input_count,
    output_count,
    dropped_count,
    error_count,
    metadata
)
SELECT
    run_id,
    'final_policy_state'::text AS stage_key,
    6 AS stage_order,
    total_count AS input_count,
    total_count AS output_count,
    0 AS dropped_count,
    0 AS error_count,
    jsonb_build_object(
        'review_pending', review_pending,
        'review_not_needed', review_not_needed,
        'review_blocked', review_blocked,
        'review_trashed', review_trashed,
        'new_pending_review', new_pending_review,
        'new_active_no_review', new_active_no_review,
        'new_blocked', new_blocked,
        'new_trashed', new_trashed
    ) AS metadata
FROM agg
ON CONFLICT (run_id, stage_key) DO UPDATE SET
    input_count = EXCLUDED.input_count,
    output_count = EXCLUDED.output_count,
    dropped_count = EXCLUDED.dropped_count,
    error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
RETURNING run_id, stage_key, stage_order, input_count, output_count, dropped_count, error_count, metadata;

WITH run_context AS (
    SELECT '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS run_id
), run_meta AS (
    SELECT run_id, COALESCE(trigger_source, 'schedule') AS trigger_source
    FROM rea_import_runs
    WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM run_context)
), events AS (
    SELECT stage_key, event_type, COALESCE(event_reason, 'ok') AS event_reason, is_new_offer
    FROM rea_import_run_offer_events
    WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM run_context)
), counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN (SELECT trigger_source FROM run_meta) = 'backfill'
            THEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'select_candidates' AND event_type = 'entered'), 0)
            ELSE COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'parse_list' AND event_type = 'entered'), 0)
        END AS entered_workflow,
        CASE WHEN (SELECT trigger_source FROM run_meta) = 'backfill'
            THEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'update_offer_after_ai' AND event_type = 'updated'), 0)
            ELSE GREATEST(
                COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'validate_before_sql' AND event_type = 'passed'), 0),
                COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'upsert_offer' AND event_type IN ('inserted', 'updated')), 0)
            )
        END AS validated_for_sql,
        CASE WHEN (SELECT trigger_source FROM run_meta) = 'backfill'
            THEN COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'update_offer_after_ai' AND event_type = 'updated'), 0)
            ELSE COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'upsert_offer' AND event_type = 'updated'), 0)
        END AS updated_existing,
        COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'ai_rate' AND event_type = 'rated'), 0) AS ai_rated,
        COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'ai_rate' AND event_type = 'failed'), 0) AS ai_parse_failed
), summary AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT run_id FROM run_context) AS run_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'entered_workflow', entered_workflow,
            'validated_for_sql', validated_for_sql,
            'dropped_before_sql', GREATEST(entered_workflow - validated_for_sql, 0),
            'drops_by_reason', COALESCE((
                SELECT jsonb_object_agg(reason, total_count)
                FROM (
                    SELECT event_reason AS reason, COUNT(*)::int AS total_count
                    FROM events
                    WHERE stage_key IN ('fetch_detail', 'merge_detail', 'validate_before_sql')
                      AND event_type = 'dropped'
                    GROUP BY event_reason
                ) aggregated
            ), '{}'::jsonb),
            'inserted_new', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'upsert_offer' AND event_type = 'inserted'), 0),
            'updated_existing', updated_existing,
            'new_to_review', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'final_policy_state' AND event_type = 'final_state' AND COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND event_reason = 'pending'), 0),
            'new_not_needed', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'final_policy_state' AND event_type = 'final_state' AND COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND event_reason = 'not_needed'), 0),
            'new_blocked', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'final_policy_state' AND event_type = 'final_state' AND COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND event_reason = 'blocked'), 0),
            'new_trashed', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE stage_key = 'final_policy_state' AND event_type = 'final_state' AND COALESCE(is_new_offer, FALSE) = TRUE AND event_reason = 'trashed'), 0),
            'ai_rated', ai_rated,
            'ai_parse_failed', ai_parse_failed
        ) AS summary
    FROM counts
)
SELECT run_id, summary
FROM summary;

WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.external_id }}'::text AS external_id,
        '{{ $json.category || 'mieszkanie-krakow' }}'::text AS category,
        '{{ $json.url }}'::text AS url,
        '{{ String($json.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS title,
        {{ Number($json.price) || 0 }}::numeric AS price,
        {{ Number($json.price_per_m2) || 0 }}::numeric AS price_per_m2,
        {{ Number($json.area) || 0 }}::numeric AS area,
        {{ Number($json.lot_size) || 0 }}::numeric AS lot_size,
        {{ Number($json.construction_year) || 0 }}::integer AS construction_year,
        '{{ String($json.property_portal || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS property_portal,
        '{{ String($json.district || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS district,
        '{{ String($json.location_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS location_text,
        '{{ $json.created_at || new Date().toISOString() }}'::timestamp AS created_at,
        NOW()::timestamp AS last_seen_at
)
INSERT INTO rea_property_offers (
    external_id, category, url, title,
    price, price_per_m2, area, lot_size,
    construction_year, ai_rating, user_rating,
    property_portal, district, location_text,
    created_at, last_seen_at
)
SELECT
    external_id, category, url, title,
    price, price_per_m2, area, lot_size,
    construction_year, NULL, 'pending',
    NULLIF(property_portal, ''), NULLIF(district, ''), NULLIF(location_text, ''),
    created_at, last_seen_at
FROM incoming
WHERE
    NULLIF(BTRIM(external_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(BTRIM(external_id)) <> 'undefined'
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM(url), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(BTRIM(url)) <> 'undefined'
    AND BTRIM(url) ~* '^https?://'
ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET
    category = EXCLUDED.category,
    url = EXCLUDED.url,
    title = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.title, ''), rea_property_offers.title),
    price = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.price, 0) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.price ELSE rea_property_offers.price END,
    price_per_m2 = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.price_per_m2, 0) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.price_per_m2 ELSE rea_property_offers.price_per_m2 END,
    area = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.area, 0) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.area ELSE rea_property_offers.area END,
    lot_size = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.lot_size, 0) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.lot_size ELSE rea_property_offers.lot_size END,
    construction_year = CASE WHEN COALESCE(EXCLUDED.construction_year, 0) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.construction_year ELSE rea_property_offers.construction_year END,
    property_portal = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.property_portal, ''), rea_property_offers.property_portal),
    district = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.district, ''), rea_property_offers.district),
    location_text = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.location_text, ''), rea_property_offers.location_text),
    last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
RETURNING *;

WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ String($json.external_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS external_id,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.area) || 0 }}::numeric AS area,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.price) || 0 }}::numeric AS price,
        '{{ String($json.ai_parsed.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS title,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.lot_size) || 0 }}::numeric AS lot_size,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.ai_rating) || 0 }}::integer AS ai_rating,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.price_per_m2) || 0 }}::numeric AS price_per_m2,
        '{{ String($json.ai_parsed.ai_analysis_html || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS ai_analysis_html,
        {{ Number($json.ai_parsed.construction_year) || 0 }}::integer AS construction_year
)
UPDATE rea_property_offers AS offers
SET
    area = incoming.area,
    price = incoming.price,
    title = incoming.title,
    lot_size = incoming.lot_size,
    ai_rating = incoming.ai_rating,
    price_per_m2 = incoming.price_per_m2,
    ai_analysis_html = incoming.ai_analysis_html,
    construction_year = incoming.construction_year,
    last_seen_at = NOW()
FROM incoming
WHERE offers.external_id = incoming.external_id
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(incoming.external_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(BTRIM(incoming.external_id)) <> 'undefined'
RETURNING offers.external_id, offers.url;

WITH rated_offers AS (
    SELECT
        external_id,
        title,
        user_notes,
        user_rated_at,
        COALESCE(
            user_grade,
            CASE user_rating
                WHEN 'like' THEN 4
                WHEN '👍 I like it' THEN 4
                WHEN 'dislike' THEN 2
                WHEN '👎 I don''t like it' THEN 2
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS effective_grade
    FROM rea_property_offers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_in_trash, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(excluded_from_feedback_loop, FALSE) = FALSE
),
best_examples AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rated_offers
    WHERE effective_grade IN (5, 4)
    ORDER BY CASE effective_grade WHEN 5 THEN 0 WHEN 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_rated_at DESC NULLS LAST, external_id
    LIMIT 3
),
worst_examples AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rated_offers
    WHERE effective_grade IN (1, 2)
    ORDER BY CASE effective_grade WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_rated_at DESC NULLS LAST, external_id
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    'BEST RATED EXAMPLES (prioritize grade 5, then 4; up to 3):',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT E'\n' || string_agg(
                format(
                    '- grade=%s | external_id=%s | title=%s | notes=%s',
                    effective_grade,
                    external_id,
                    COALESCE(left(title, 140), 'n/a'),
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(left(user_notes, 200), ''), 'none')
                ),
                E'\n'
            )
            FROM best_examples
        ),
        E'\n- none yet'
    ),
    E'\n\nWORST RATED EXAMPLES (prioritize grade 1, then 2; up to 3):',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT E'\n' || string_agg(
                format(
                    '- grade=%s | external_id=%s | title=%s | notes=%s',
                    effective_grade,
                    external_id,
                    COALESCE(left(title, 140), 'n/a'),
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(left(user_notes, 200), ''), 'none')
                ),
                E'\n'
            )
            FROM worst_examples
        ),
        E'\n- none yet'
    )
) AS feedback_hint;

SELECT * FROM rea_property_offers
WHERE external_id = '{{ String($json.external_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  AND COALESCE(is_in_trash, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(url, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(url, ''))) <> 'undefined'
  AND BTRIM(url) ~* '^https?://'
LIMIT 1;

WITH rated_offers AS (
    SELECT
        external_id,
        title,
        user_notes,
        user_rated_at,
        COALESCE(
            user_grade,
            CASE user_rating
                WHEN 'like' THEN 4
                WHEN '👍 I like it' THEN 4
                WHEN 'dislike' THEN 2
                WHEN '👎 I don''t like it' THEN 2
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS effective_grade
    FROM rea_property_offers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_in_trash, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(excluded_from_feedback_loop, FALSE) = FALSE
),
best_examples AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rated_offers
    WHERE effective_grade IN (5, 4)
    ORDER BY CASE effective_grade WHEN 5 THEN 0 WHEN 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_rated_at DESC NULLS LAST, external_id
    LIMIT 3
),
worst_examples AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rated_offers
    WHERE effective_grade IN (1, 2)
    ORDER BY CASE effective_grade WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, user_rated_at DESC NULLS LAST, external_id
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT CONCAT(
    'BEST RATED EXAMPLES (prioritize grade 5, then 4; up to 3):',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT E'\n' || string_agg(
                format(
                    '- grade=%s | external_id=%s | title=%s | notes=%s',
                    effective_grade,
                    external_id,
                    COALESCE(left(title, 140), 'n/a'),
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(left(user_notes, 200), ''), 'none')
                ),
                E'\n'
            )
            FROM best_examples
        ),
        E'\n- none yet'
    ),
    E'\n\nWORST RATED EXAMPLES (prioritize grade 1, then 2; up to 3):',
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT E'\n' || string_agg(
                format(
                    '- grade=%s | external_id=%s | title=%s | notes=%s',
                    effective_grade,
                    external_id,
                    COALESCE(left(title, 140), 'n/a'),
                    COALESCE(NULLIF(left(user_notes, 200), ''), 'none')
                ),
                E'\n'
            )
            FROM worst_examples
        ),
        E'\n- none yet'
    )
) AS feedback_hint;

=# SYSTEM PROMPT: KRAKOW REAL ESTATE ANALYSIS EXPERT ## ROLE You are a precise real estate market analyst. Your task is to extract technical data from the listing HTML code and assign a rating (ai_rating) based on defined user preferences. ## PROPERTY-TYPE FIRST RULE Before scoring, determine the property type from the title and HTML. Distinguish between: - apartment in a multi-unit building - house, semi-detached house, townhouse, segment - house-like unit or apartment marketed as "jak dom" Apply only criteria that make sense for that property type. Do not penalize a listing for missing features that are irrelevant for its type. ## YOUR PREFERENCES (RATING CRITERIA) Assign `ai_rating` on a 1-10 scale, where 10 is the highest rating, considering: - **Location:**: Krakow (highest score: South Krakow). - **Area**: minimum 90 sqm. - **Layout:**: 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, terrace. - **Amenities**: elevator, but only when relevant for apartments in multi-unit buildings. Do not lower the rating for houses, semi-detached homes, townhouses, segments, or house-like units for lacking an elevator. - **Negatives (lower the rating):**: electric heating, gas. - **Building type**: boutique (under 50 apartments), but only when the listing is an apartment in a multi-unit building. Treat this as not applicable for houses and house-like units, not as a negative. ## HINT FROM PAST USER FEEDBACK Use the following past user decisions as a soft hint only. Prioritize strong signals first: grade 5 over 4, and grade 1 over 2. Prefer current listing facts over pattern matching. {{ $json.feedback_hint }} ## INPUT DATA - **EXTERNAL_ID**: {{ $json.external_id }} - **Title**: {{ $json.title }} - **Input price**: {{ $json.price }} PLN - **Input price per m2**: {{ $json.price_per_m2 }} PLN - **Area**: {{ $json.area }} m2 - **Lot size**: {{ $json.lot_size }} m2 - **Construction year**: {{ $json.construction_year }} ## LISTING PAGE CONTENT (FOR ANALYSIS)##: {{ $json.ai_input_md }} ## DATA EXTRACTION INSTRUCTIONS Analyse the provided listing content inside and find and fill in gaps in the input data: 1. **title**: Full, attractive listing title. 2. **price**: Total property price (remove "PLN", "PLN", spaces). Return as a number. 3. **price_per_m2**: Price per sqm. If not available, calculate: price / area. 4. **area**: Apartment area (number). 5. **lot_size**: Exclusive garden or plot size in square meters (`m2`). If the listing gives a garden or plot size, return that value in `m2`. Do not convert to ares. For properties without an exclusive garden or plot, return 0. 6. **year**: Construction year (if missing, estimate or use 0). 7. **ai_rating**: Your rating (1-10) based on the above preferences. ## EMAIL SUMMARY PREPARATION INSTRUCTIONS (email_html_content field) Generate HTML content to be inserted into the email summary section. Focus on substantive analysis. HTML content requirements: AI Verdict: Brief justification of the ai_rating score (np. "Ideal area and location, but deducting points for gas"). Pros Analysis: List features matching preferences (np. southern location, terrace, boutique building, 2 bathrooms). Risk Analysis (Cons): Clearly indicate what lowered the rating. Mention "no elevator" only when elevator is relevant for that property type. Do not treat lack of elevator or lack of boutique-building evidence as a defect for houses, semi-detached homes, townhouses, segments, or house-like units. Location: Provide the most precise location possible (district, street). Styling: Use clean HTML. Use ,
    ,
  • . Do not add CSS styles inside this field (they will be overridden by the n8n template). Example structure inside the string: "Listing analysis: The apartment meets the key area requirement (90m2+) and has the desired 3-bedroom layout.
    • ✅ South Krakow (Debniki)
    • ✅ Terrace and 2 bathrooms
    • ❌ Gas heating (rating lowered)
    " ## OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT JSON) Return ONLY a clean JSON object. Do not add any comments or introductions. Under no circumstances modify the EXTERNAL_ID value = {{ $json.external_id }} EXTERNAL_ID is in text format, type "string" { "external_id": "string", "title": "string", "price": number, "price_per_m2": number, "area": number, "lot_size": number, "construction_year": number, "ai_rating": number, "ai_analysis_html": "string" }

WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS run_id,
        '{{ String($json.stage_key || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS stage_key,
        {{ Number($json.stage_order) || 0 }}::int AS stage_order,
        '{{ String($json.external_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS external_id,
        {{ $json.url ? "'" + String($json.url).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}::text AS url,
        '{{ String($json.event_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS event_type,
        {{ $json.event_reason ? "'" + String($json.event_reason).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}::text AS event_reason,
        '{{ (() => { const payload = $json.payload; const text = typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload ?? {}); return text.replace(/'/g, "''"); })() }}'::jsonb AS payload
)
INSERT INTO rea_import_run_offer_events
    (run_id, stage_key, stage_order, external_id, url, event_type, event_reason, payload)
SELECT
    run_id,
    stage_key,
    stage_order,
    external_id,
    url,
    event_type,
    event_reason,
    payload
FROM incoming
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(run_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(BTRIM(run_id)) <> 'undefined'
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(stage_key), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(external_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(BTRIM(external_id)) <> 'undefined';

INSERT INTO rea_import_run_stage_metrics
    (run_id, stage_key, stage_order, input_count, output_count, dropped_count, error_count, metadata)
VALUES (
    '{{ String($json.run_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.stage_key || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    {{ Number($json.stage_order) || 0 }},
    {{ Number($json.input_count) || 0 }},
    {{ Number($json.output_count) || 0 }},
    {{ Number($json.dropped_count) || 0 }},
    {{ Number($json.error_count) || 0 }},
    '{{ (() => { const metadata = $json.metadata; const text = typeof metadata === 'string' ? metadata : JSON.stringify(metadata ?? {}); return text.replace(/'/g, "''"); })() }}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (run_id, stage_key) DO UPDATE SET
    input_count = EXCLUDED.input_count,
    output_count = EXCLUDED.output_count,
    dropped_count = EXCLUDED.dropped_count,
    error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata;

WITH ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(BTRIM(value), '') AS external_id
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text('{{ JSON.stringify($json.external_ids || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb) AS t(value)
    WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(value), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(p.external_id), '[]'::json) AS existing_ids
FROM rea_property_offers p
JOIN ids ON ids.external_id = p.external_id;
